title: Chinese cities are offering free apartments and office space to attract and incubate "one-person companies", startups run by a single founder with AI's help (Viola Zhou/Rest of World)
summary: Viola Zhou / Rest of World: Chinese cities are offering free apartments and office space to attract and incubate “one-person companies”, startups run by a single founder with AI's help — Under a national AI push, local governments are turning coworking space and data centers into AI incubators.
